about.title: Why choose me?
about.desc1: Freelance web developer based in Madagascar, creative design, WordPress, WooCommerce, and SEO expert, with over 5 years of experience and more than 50 professional websites designed across various sectors.
about.desc2: As a registered freelancer, I offer reliable services that meet professional standards.

2021.title: Initiation and passion
2021.content: Started as a web developer and web development trainer. Discovered my passion for this job, shared experiences and built websites for IT service companies, training centers, blogs, travel and tourism projects. Creation and customization of WordPress themes

2024.title: Freelance and expansion
2024.content: With three years of experience, I worked as a subcontractor for French companies. Solving countless technical problems and bugs. Interventions and creation of simple and complex websites, particularly in real estate, rental investment, and various front-end projects.

2025.title: Experience and versatility
2025.content: Experienced developer, WordPress specialist and pixel-perfect integrator. Interventions in numerous web projects for Malagasy, French and Canadian companies. Collaboration with NGOs, organizations, real estate sectors, women's centers, concierge services and various other fields. Expertise in web performance and technical SEO.

2026.title: Confirmed expertise
2026.content: Always driven by my passion, I continue my activity as a registered freelancer. Having become an expert webmaster, WordPress holds no secrets for me: theme creation and customization, plugin development, web performance optimization and technical SEO. Mastery of Gutenberg, WooCommerce, Elementor, Divi, Avada and many other tools. I have reached about fifty completed projects, confirming my expertise and versatility.

testimonials.title: What they wrote

item1.question: Why choose me?
item1.answer: We create high-performing, custom-tailored, and optimized websites. Beyond aesthetic design, we guarantee flawless fluidity, effective SEO, and an engaging user experience. Furthermore, we support you at every step and provide comprehensive training so you can manage your site completely independently.

item2.question: You are based in Madagascar, how do you handle the time difference?
item2.answer: The time difference poses no problem in our collaboration. Our responsive team adapts to your working hours to ensure regular follow-up and smooth communication, regardless of your time zone.

item3.question: Why trust me?
item3.answer: Our clients often say that working with us is like finding a rare gem on the internet: we prioritize transparency, technical excellence, and a trusting partnership.

item4.question: How can I track the progress of my project?
item4.answer: We use modern project management tools so you have total real-time visibility. You receive regular updates and can check the progress of your website at any time.

item5.question: What are your rates?
item5.answer: Our rates are very affordable and adapt according to the complexity and specifics of your project. Contact us directly to get a personalized, no-obligation quote.

item6.question: Do you guarantee the quality of your services?
item6.answer: Yes, absolutely. Each project is carried out with rigor, transparency, and professionalism. We are committed to delivering reliable, durable results that perfectly meet your expectations.
